title: Rust, Go, C#, F# and Ruby on the web
summary: A service written only in Rust, only in Go, only in C# or only in F# runs on every target. A host that links the service runs it natively: Rust on macOS, Windows and Linux, and C# on Windows. The other targets run it as WebAssembly: the web, iOS and Android for Rust, and every target except Windows for C#. No host links Go or F#, so a Go or F# service runs as WebAssembly on every target. An F# service runs on the same .NET browser runtime as C# (ADR 0073). A Ruby service runs on every target too, on Tachyon's mruby WebAssembly runtime, which your machine builds once with Ruby and Emscripten (ADR 0049, ADR 0054). The WebAssembly service uses the same companion protocol (ADR 0035, ADR 0037, ADR 0045). Views read its fields, methods receive JSON arguments, and `Service` and `NeedsAll` are declared above its type.
